documentation.subject: DC46 file-link worker logged an error
documentation.content:
## What this means

The worker `processFileLinkRevocations` wrote a log line at ERROR level. This notification is sent at most once an hour, so more errors may have followed; it does not contain the log line. Open Logs Explorer with:

`resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="processfilelinkrevocations" AND severity>=ERROR`

## Read the message, then act

| Log message contains | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `worker run failed` | The run threw. | Read the stack in the entry. If it repeats every minute, policy A will also fire. |
| `FILE_LINK_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_HOURS is set but` | The interval value is invalid. Revocation still runs; reconciliation is off; every run fails. | Correct the value in `functions/.env.constrapp-69b5d` and redeploy the worker (authorised deploy). |
| `sweep interrupted; will resume` | A Storage listing or a Firestore call failed. The checkpoint is kept. | One line is usually transient. Five in a row close the sweep as incomplete. |
| `sweep incomplete; old links may still work` | Third or later incomplete sweep for a company. Retries back off, up to one hour apart. | Read `companies/{id}/system/fileLinkRevocation` (`lastPass`, `consecutiveIncomplete`, `nextAttemptAt`). Old links for that company may still work until a sweep completes. |
| `reconciliation overdue` | A company has gone two intervals without a successful sweep. | Find the company from its `overdueSince` field and treat as an incomplete sweep. |
| `reconciliation cursor unreadable` / `could not be read` / `planning failed` | Planning restarted or will retry. No company is skipped. | Check that it does not repeat. |
| `refusing an invalid company id` | A queue document sits under an invalid company id. | Investigate who wrote it; the worker ignores it. |

Never paste a download URL or a token into a ticket or chat.

Full runbook: `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`, section *DC46-C monitoring readiness*.
